Messages.Author: Suoli
Messages.Body:
1. Can Fakir al-Sidi's special be used on a referendum that would pass automatically?

The only ruling I found on this said that "most during referendum-effects aren't playable" but that's not very comprehensive.

2. Does Fakir's timing window refer to a discrete "before votes are cast" step, similar to the "before range" step? I.e., can you use his special any time during the action before votes are cast or right before votes are cast?

Thanks in advance.

Fakir al Sidi
Clan: Gangrel (group 4)
Capacity: 11
Disciplines: ANI FOR PRE PRO THA abo
Independent: Before votes are cast, Fakir may burn 3 blood to cause the referendum of a political action to fail. He gets an optional press each combat. +1 bleed. +1 strength.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
If the vote passes automatically, there's no voting phase, and effects usable "before votes are cast" or "during a referendum" can't be used.

Effects usable "on a successful referendum" (such as another Cryptic Rider or a Voter Captivation for a gain of 0 blood) can be used.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> KevinM wrote:
> Fakir's should properly read During a referendum, before votes are cast,....
>
It's redundant because his cardtext already mentions "... the referendum of a political action".

Furthermore, votes are cast only during a referendum, and "before votes are cast" only apply if the action was successful => a referendum is being conducted.

You can't use "before votes are cast" effects before the referendum if you don't even know for instance whether the action will be blocked or not.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
